chapter: Fellow musicians: Kirk, Bunk, Parker, McShann
title: Lovett on Thamon Hayes as leader
summary: Lovett praises Hayes as an honest manager and nondrinker.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Well, would you like to add --. Well Baby, of course, we went on the first tape when Basie called you to join him in Newark, New Jersey so I think that pretty much brings us up to date on the Moten band. I'd like to now throw some names out of personnel and see what you have

to say about them. Baby, what have you got to say about your old bandleader, Thamon Hayes? Thamon was a great manager, great manager and an honest man, I'll say that for him, and of course you get a little nervous out there in front, you know, but I liked him very much as a leader, you understand?
Yeh, he was a wonderful guy. Didn't drink either, that's another thing. He didn't drink a drop of nothing.
Well. Just like you and Baby me, huh?
That's right. See we don't drop a drink but he didn't drink a drop.
